title: Excellent bikes and service
text: All questions prior to our visit were adequately replied. We had 1 e-bike and 1 'normal' bike, both where high quality and in excellent technical condition. The staff and owner were most helpful. We are very pleased and gratefull for your service! Thanks again!
author: 956wimf

title: Biking in Seville
text: The bikes and bike shop were great. Quality bikes    Biking in Seville though underwhelming. Too many cars.  Not enough natural beauty. Lots of bike paths but not a lot to look at.
author: M7141ECruthh

title: Beautiful Seville
text: Rented electric bicycles for 1 day during our visit to Seville. Quality of the bicycles was excellent. We cycled around Plaza de Espagna, the banks of the river, through Triana, the Alamillo park and back via the old center. Seen a lot and really enjoyed the breaks on the many terraces.
author: peternl888

title: e-bike rental sevilla
text: the bikes are very good. Wide tires that gave a feeling of stability. Good service and excellent price-quality ratio. Easy to arrange online
author: jelmarp2024

title: Recommended bike rental service !!
text: excellent service: the very friendly and helpful owner helped to pick out the best bikes according to our length and very clearly explained how to use them. He also did some suggestions on what places in Sevilla to visit and the placed that were not so suited to visit by bike. We also rented a additional bike bag for only 1,5 €. The E-bikes were high-quality material. So wend absolutely recommend this rental service.

title: Own bike tour
text: I went out of the city by bike and saw a lot of beautiful things along the way. They are very nice e-bikes with which you can go on a long trip.

title: FANTASTIC EXPERIENCE
text: Fully recommended. Walking around Seville by bike proved to be an experience, easy, pleasant. At Elecmove they helped us in everything giving us all the facilities. Activity and Enterprise highly recommended.
